subject.title: Agents: tighten tool name trust and preflight tool collisions

question: Should this protected maintainer PR be closed as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/67303, or should a narrow unique delta be rebased on current main?
rationale: Automation should not close a member-authored PR with the maintainer label, and the remaining choice is whether maintainers want to preserve any unique branch work beyond the shipped implementation.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Confirm there is no unique hardening beyond current main and close this protected branch in favor of the shipped canonical PR.

options.title: Rebase a narrow delta
options.body: Keep only demonstrably unique changes, remove the changelog edit, and preserve current main's trusted plugin-media and SSE conflict contracts.

options.title: Accept the API change
options.body: If maintainers want streaming conflicts to return JSON before SSE, document and prove that compatibility change explicitly before merge.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Confirm there is no unique hardening beyond current main and close this protected branch in favor of the shipped canonical PR.
